WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j)
UPDATE discord_giveaways
SET message_id = (SELECT p.j->>'messageId' FROM p)
WHERE id = (SELECT (p.j->>'id')::bigint FROM p);

WITH today AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::int AS d,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::int AS m,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo'))::int AS y
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE discord_birthdays b
  SET last_announced_year = (SELECT y FROM today)
  FROM today t
  WHERE b.birth_day = t.d AND b.birth_month = t.m AND b.last_announced_year IS DISTINCT FROM t.y
  RETURNING b.user_id, b.username, b.guild_id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'birthdays', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(updated)) FROM updated), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS result;

WITH due AS (
  UPDATE discord_giveaways
  SET ended = TRUE
  WHERE ended = FALSE AND ends_at <= NOW() AND message_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id, channel_id, message_id, prize, winners_count
)
SELECT id, channel_id, message_id, prize, winners_count FROM due;
